item.title: Solano County joins statewide human trafficking crackdown

item.title: Sorce returns with ideas from mayors’ conference
item.description: Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey, along with mayors from all over the Bay Area and the country, exchanged information on topics including successful practices regarding Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) enforcement in the nation’s cities at the Jan. 28-30 conference.

item.title: Prep girls soccer: Vacaville celebrates Senior Night with rout of Vanden
item.description: The Bulldogs (15-1-2, 8-0) have now won nine straight and can claim sole possession of the Monticello Empire League title with a win over River City (7-1) on Thursday.

item.title: Local Roundup: Vanden boys basketball drops crucial MEL contest to Sacramento
item.description: Vanden’s hopes for its seventh straight MEL title are still mathematically alive, but unlikely, as Sacramento would have to lose at least two of its final three games. If the Dragons hold on, they would claim their first MEL title since joining the league a season ago.
